clips.send: Flowing Water, Guqin In the tale “High Mountains and Flowing Water,” Zhong Ziqi hears mountains and streams in Boya’s guqin playing. When Ziqi dies, Boya breaks his instrument. A friend who understands you that well is a zhīyīn. Hear the guqin piece Liú Shuǐ (Flowing Water). Listen for plucks and slides. Which sounds make you picture flowing water?

clips.send: Beethoven, Symphony No. 5, I. Allegro con brio A motif is a small musical idea a composer can repeat and change. Beethoven starts with three short sounds and a long one. Tap short–short–short–long. Can you still find that pattern when the pitches change?

clips.send: 先保持速度和力度不变，对比大调和小调。再只改一个滑块，重听其中一版。什么变了？原来的感受还在吗？ 把第三级音从 E 降到 E ，旋律就有了小调色彩。熟悉西方音乐的人可能会觉得它忧郁。试试加快速度或增强力度，你的感受会变吗？
